title: Everything you need to stay organized and inspired
use_cases: Use when you want to automatically catalog story elements without manual data entry
Implement when visual timeline tracking of character arcs and narrative beats is required
Configure when mapping complex relationships between characters, locations, and items
Use when analyzing plot progression, conflict distribution, and story stakes
Implement when organizing world-building mechanics and fictional social structures
content:
Mythril instantly catalogs every character, location, item, and plot event into a beautiful, searchable reference guide, with no manual data entry required

#### World concepts, organized

All of your story’s concepts intuitively grouped and prioritized

#### Visualize every timeline

See key events and narrative beats for all of your compendium objects

#### Deep character tracking

Automatic profiles summarizing appearance, personality, dialogue and plot interactions

#### Plot & structure analysis

Assess your story progression and how you are conveying conflict and stakes

#### Relationship mapping

See how your world’s people, places and things connect at a glance

#### Every setting, recorded

From sprawling cities to intimate taverns, browse and inspect all your story locations

#### Track meaningful objects

Recall the tiny details for the many magical and mundane items that drive your plot

#### Mechanics & systems codified

Rules, systems and social structures are automatically captured for your review
